recommendation: Conduct home-based transportation needs assessment and resource connection
implementation_steps: Conduct home visits to assess transportation needs and available resources
Connect patients to community transportation resources and programs
Provide education on available transportation options and how to access them
Help patients navigate public transportation systems when appropriate
Follow up to ensure successful connection to transportation services
evidence_summary: CHW-led transportation needs assessment and resource connection interventions have demonstrated improvements in healthcare access and appointment attendance for patients with transportation barriers.
